target_customer: Retail merchants and shoppers at point of sale who would pay by fingerprint
problem: Card payments need cards, PINs or phones; Whirl claimed a proprietary terminal could take a fingerprint payment in about one second with chip card level security.
business_model: Proprietary payment terminal and payment processing for merchants; pricing not found

founders.name: Steve Sobel
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page, which gives no bio.

competitors.name: PayTango
competitors.what: Fingerprint payments at campus merchants using an off the shelf scanner and card reader
competitors.traction_then: Working at three Carnegie Mellon locations, 100 students signed up in four hours

competitors.name: Yapital
competitors.what: European payment provider testing fingerprint scan payments as an alternative to PIN entry

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom fingerprint terminal hardware with secure matching and payment network integration is hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: No evidence of patents or exclusive merchant deals; hardware and enrolled users could lock in merchants but nothing sourced shows traction.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Apple launched Touch ID in 2013 and Apple Pay in 2014, shifting fingerprint payments to phones; this is general context and no source ties it to Whirl.

market_need_then: Fingerprint sensors on phones and the Apple Pay launch in late 2014 raised interest in biometric payments, but no Whirl specific evidence of merchant demand was found.

branding.domain_note: Used getwhirl.com; it now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found, and the name is shared by many unrelated Whirl companies.

outcome_analysis: Whirl was a two person YC Summer 2014 company building a fingerprint payment terminal and left no independent press, funding record or post-mortem in the searches run. The company website is now a domain for sale page. The cause of the shutdown is not public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Searches for Whirl mostly returned other companies (Whirlscape, Whirl AI, a crowdfunding project) that are not this company. Yapital date is taken from the article URL 201407. Education and prior employers not found. Exit type shutdown inferred from YC status Inactive.
